data.cultural_impact: The name Scotti held an important cultural significance in medieval Scotland. It was originally used as a surname for the Scottish clans who lived in the northern and western regions of the country. These highlanders were often considered outsiders by the southern, Lowland Scottish communities. The name Scotti helped to distinguish and define the Scottish identity, contributing to a sense of unity and pride among the Scottish Highlanders.
